similar_in_english: Shake the dust off one's feet
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বাড়ি থেকে ফিরে এসে গায়ে ধুলো দিয়ে ঘৃণা প্রকাশ করল।
বাজার থেকে ফিরে ধুলো দিয়ে তার অসন্তোষ দেখাল।
example_sentences_in_english: He came back from her house and shook the dust off his clothes to express his disgust.
After the market visit, she dusted herself off to show her contempt.
history: This idiom originates from the rural practice of shaking dust off one's clothes after visiting an unwelcome place, symbolizing rejection and disdain in Bengali folk culture.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali gestures of non-verbal communication in social disdain.
